remarks:
Discover the perfect blend of privacy and convenience with this beautiful 7.22-acre wooded parcel in the heart of ski country. Just 7 minutes from the Village of Ellicottville and Holiday Valley, and only 5 minutes to HoliMont Ski Resort, this property offers an exceptional location for year-round enjoyment.
Surrounded by mature, towering trees, this scenic lot provides the ideal setting to build your dream home, vacation retreat, or cozy cabin in the woods. Whether you're looking for a peaceful getaway, a recreational property, or a place to create lasting memories with family and friends, the possibilities are endless.
An annual HOA fee of $850 covers private road maintenance, providing convenient year-round access while preserving the area's natural beauty.
If you've been searching for a property that combines acreage, privacy, and close proximity to Ellicottville's renowned skiing, golfing, hiking, mountain biking, dining, and entertainment, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Come experience everything this exceptional property has to offer!
